usage.summary:
Gate passed on run 2 of 4.

Added the seeded, in-memory conformance driver and aligned model actions with the code’s observable events. `lib/history.ts` and all ratified statements remain unchanged.

Within the one-item, two-load bounds, TLC explored 464 states: all invariants held, every witness was reached, all three known bugs were caught, and conformance and build checks passed.

pins.name: Spec
pins.says: Sequential browser loads follow the migration, with one local item identified by its kind and name and at most two loads.

pins.name: NoItemLost
pins.says: The completion flag is set and local deletion is requested only after every local item is shared under the same kind and name.

pins.name: FailedLoadsStayRetryable
pins.says: A read abort or error settles as a failure, and a failed load returns with its database closed, its local library retained and its completion flag unset for retry.

pins.name: ReadsWaitForCommit
pins.says: Metadata and bytes are used only after their read transactions complete, never on request success alone.

pins.name: CompletedLoadsAreIdle
pins.says: After a completed migration returns, later loads keep its flag and make no database, shared-library or flag-write calls.

pins.name: NoSourceDoesNoMigration
pins.says: Unavailable local storage causes no migration work, and an absent old database causes no uploads or deletion requests.

pins.name: TypeOK
pins.says: Every phase, transaction status, library key, flag and call count stays within its declared type and bounds.

pins.name: UploadThenSkip
pins.says: An item can upload successfully, permit deletion and make the next load do nothing.

pins.name: RetryThenFinish
pins.says: A failed first load can retry and finish migration on the second load.

pins.name: AlreadySharedFinishes
pins.says: An item already shared under the same kind and name can complete migration without an upload.

pins.name: AbsentFinishes
pins.says: A browser without the old database can mark migration complete without uploading or requesting deletion.

pins.name: UnavailableReturns
pins.says: A browser without local storage can return without doing migration work.

pins.name: MissingBytesSkipped
pins.says: Skipping a missing blob lets migration mark an uncopied item complete.

pins.name: AbortIgnored
pins.says: Ignoring a read transaction abort leaves the invocation stranded with its database open.

pins.name: RequestSuccessUsed
pins.says: Resolving a read on request success uses its result before the transaction completes.

usage.summary:
I found problems in step selection, argument coverage, and bound handling.

- [conformance.ts:269](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-review-3010347714/conformance.ts:269) suppresses `load` whenever an invocation remains pending. This filters attempts using implementation state, preventing the code from demonstrating whether it refuses another load.
- [conformance.ts:351](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-review-3010347714/conformance.ts:351) offers only six operation kinds. Actions named by `Next`, including `CheckFlag`, `ChooseItem`, `MarkComplete`, `CloseDatabase`, and `RequestDeletion`, cannot be selected independently. FIFO delivery and automatic continuation draining exercise only the implementation’s chosen sequence.
- [conformance.ts:282](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-review-3010347714/conformance.ts:282) targets read failures only at the latest transaction, whereas `ReadRejects(which, reason)` permits independently choosing metadata or bytes. Likewise, blob presence is fixed during construction, so `BlobRequestSuccess(result)` cannot independently sample both results at each attempt.
- [conformance.ts:269](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-review-3010347714/conformance.ts:269) hardcodes the load limit as `2`, without a top-level `MaxLoads` constant. The stated gate mechanism therefore cannot enlarge this driver bound alongside TLC’s.

I read the driver, model, and manifest. The supplied directory lacks the imported implementation, so I could not verify its actual size parameters. Nothing was changed.

review.text:
I found problems in step selection, argument coverage, and bound handling.

- [conformance.ts:269](conformance.ts:269) suppresses `load` whenever an invocation remains pending. This filters attempts using implementation state, preventing the code from demonstrating whether it refuses another load.
- [conformance.ts:351](conformance.ts:351) offers only six operation kinds. Actions named by `Next`, including `CheckFlag`, `ChooseItem`, `MarkComplete`, `CloseDatabase`, and `RequestDeletion`, cannot be selected independently. FIFO delivery and automatic continuation draining exercise only the implementation’s chosen sequence.
- [conformance.ts:282](conformance.ts:282) targets read failures only at the latest transaction, whereas `ReadRejects(which, reason)` permits independently choosing metadata or bytes. Likewise, blob presence is fixed during construction, so `BlobRequestSuccess(result)` cannot independently sample both results at each attempt.
- [conformance.ts:269](conformance.ts:269) hardcodes the load limit as `2`, without a top-level `MaxLoads` constant. The stated gate mechanism therefore cannot enlarge this driver bound alongside TLC’s.

I read the driver, model, and manifest. The supplied directory lacks the imported implementation, so I could not verify its actual size parameters. Nothing was changed.
